title_en: Fall 2026 Undergraduate Course Guide, Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering
summary: Students registering for Fall 2026 undergraduate courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering should consult the attached course guide when completing course registration. Any changes will be announced through this notice, so students should check it regularly. Changes may appear later on the course registration website (http://sugang.snu.ac.kr) than in this notice.
applies_to: Students registering for Fall 2026 undergraduate courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기·정보공학부). The notice is for reference during course registration; it does not state that any action is mandatory.
conditions: Any changes to the course information will be announced through this notice, so students should check it regularly.
Changes may be reflected on the course registration website later than they are announced in this notice.

Two professors in the department share the same name and are distinguished by (S) and (B): the professor marked (S) specialises in semiconductors, and the professor marked (B) specialises in communications (bio). Check which professor teaches a course before registering.
steps: Read the attached Fall 2026 course guide, '[붙임] 2026학년도 2학기 교과목 안내책자_전기정보공학부.pdf'. Its contents were not read for this translation.
Check this notice regularly for any changes to the course information.
Register for courses on the course registration website (http://sugang.snu.ac.kr), noting whether a course is taught by the professor marked (S) or the professor marked (B).
translation:
Fall 2026 Undergraduate Course Guide, Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

We provide the following guide to undergraduate courses for Fall 2026. Please refer to it when registering for courses (수강신청).

Any changes will be announced through this notice, so please check it regularly. (Changes may be reflected somewhat later on the course registration website (http://sugang.snu.ac.kr).)

※ Please note that two professors share the same name: the professor marked (S) specialises in semiconductors, and the professor marked (B) specialises in communications (bio). (The professors' names are given in the original notice.)

Attachment: Fall 2026 course guide, 1 copy.

Attached file (1): [붙임] 2026학년도 2학기 교과목 안내책자_전기정보공학부.pdf (260 KB). The contents of this attachment were not read for this translation. For questions, contact the department office; contact details are in the original notice.
